description: Every AC has a ready case; eligibility copying waits on F-1.

analysis.summary: Clone creates a Draft copy of the reward set-up without dates or CRM links. Eligibility rules are not mentioned; CRM-side visibility of the clone is unclear.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cloning a promotion creates a new promotion in Draft status with a new id.
The clone copies the reward configuration, including all tiers, of the source promotion.
The clone does not copy the start and end dates; both are empty in the clone.
The clone is not linked to any CRM campaign of the source promotion.
Cloning an archived promotion is allowed; cloning a deleted promotion is rejected.

findings.text: Are the eligibility rules (country list, player segments) copied? AC-2 only names the reward configuration.
Does the CRM side see the clone at all before it is linked manually?
What name does the clone get and must names be unique?

risks.title: Clone triggers live CRM communication
risks.description: A clone still linked to a running campaign could be advertised before it is configured.

risks.title: Clone activates with old dates
risks.description: Copied dates could start the clone immediately.

risks.title: Tiers partially copied
risks.description: Tier thresholds or percentages are lost on cloning.

test_cases.title: Clone of an active promotion is a Draft with a new id
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.expected_result: A new promotion exists with an id different from PROMO-A and status Draft; PROMO-A stays Active.

test_cases.title: Clone copies all tiers with thresholds and percentages
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.action: Clone PROMO-A and open the clone's tiers.

test_cases.title: Clone copies the eligibility rules of the source
test_cases.objective: AC-2 scope: depends on F-1 (are eligibility rules part of the copy?).
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.action: Clone PROMO-A whose country list is DE, AT and open the clone's eligibility.
steps.expected_result: The eligibility matches the PO answer to F-1.

test_cases.title: Clone has empty start and end dates
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.action: Clone PROMO-A and open the clone's schedule.
steps.expected_result: Start date and end date are both empty.

test_cases.title: Clone is not linked to the source's CRM campaign
test_cases.objective: AC-4: holds regardless of F-2 (CRM visibility).
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.action: Clone PROMO-A and open the clone's linked campaigns.
steps.expected_result: The clone has no linked CRM campaign.
PROMO-A is still linked to 'Autumn reload'.

test_cases.title: An archived promotion can be cloned
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.action: Archive a copy of PROMO-A, then clone the archived promotion.
steps.expected_result: A new Draft promotion is created.

test_cases.title: Cloning a deleted promotion is rejected
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in
Promotion PROMO-A is Active, has 3 tiers (10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%), dates 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 and is linked to CRM campaign 'Autumn reload'

steps.action: Delete promotion PROMO-B, then request a clone of PROMO-B.
steps.expected_result: The clone is rejected and no new promotion is created.
